dispute_ticket.description: I was charged S$8 for no-show at Holland Village but I told the driver I would be late. This is unfair, please refund the S$8.

app_events.details: Rider R-7108 booked RYDE-DA-008, Holland Village MRT to Tiong Bahru Plaza. Pickup 21:00.
Driver arrived at pickup, GPS at pickup point.
Driver called rider; answered, rider said still at dinner.
Rider phone location 1.1 km from pickup.
Driver cancelled, reason rider_no_show, 9 min after arrival.
S$8.00 no-show fee charged to rider credit card.

chat_logs.content: Hi, I am at Holland Village MRT Exit A.
Still at the restaurant, need another 15 min, can you wait?
I can only wait a little more, please hurry.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee S$8.00 applied.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from the driver_arrived event, before the rider counts as a no-show and the no-show fee may be charged.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider for a no-show, once the driver has waited at the pickup point for the full no-show threshold. It does not cover a cancellation the driver makes before the threshold is reached.

driver_must_contact_rider.text: Before cancelling for no-show the driver must have tried to reach the rider by in-app call or chat message during the wait. A call or message logged in the trip record counts as contact.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: driver_arrived 21:00 at the pickup; cancelled 21:09 = 9 min, over the 8 min threshold. The driver messaged at 21:01 and 21:07 and called at 21:02 (answered). The rider's own message at 21:06 says he needed 15 more minutes and his phone was 1.1 km away. The S$8.00 fee is valid; refund S$0.
